cases.requirements: Return the first count items from a list of integers. count is a nonnegative integer.
acceptance: Keep the order and return all count items when available.

cases.requirements: Append item to supplied items and return it. Supplied items is a list; explicit None is outside the input domain. Omitting items starts a new independent list on every call.
acceptance: Successive calls without items do not share data.

cases.requirements: Return a list of integers in ascending order, preserving duplicates.
acceptance: The result length equals the input length.

cases.requirements: Return the arithmetic average; for an empty sequence return 0.
acceptance: Empty and nonempty inputs both follow the contract.

cases.requirements: Clamp value to the inclusive interval [low, high]. value, low and high are finite real numbers, and low <= high.
acceptance: Both boundaries are returned exactly and interior values remain unchanged.
cases.candidate:
def clamp(value, low, high):
    return max(low, min(value, high))

cases.requirements: Return whether any item in a sequence is negative.
acceptance: Empty input is false, zero is not negative.
cases.candidate:
def has_negative(values):
    return any(value < 0 for value in values)

cases.requirements: Given normalized absolute POSIX paths (no dot segments or symlinks), return whether path equals root or is under root. root is not slash and has no trailing slash.
acceptance: A sibling with a shared textual prefix is outside root.
cases.baseline:
def contains(root, path):
    return path == root or path.startswith(root + "/")

cases.requirements: Decode an unsigned integer from exactly two bytes, in big-endian order.
acceptance: The high bit is part of the nonnegative magnitude.
